decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits squarely within the firm's core hydraulic steelwork knowledge, so it can read early field results and refine the design with little added learning cost.

The energy management system builds on the firm's automation software and its strategic direction toward energy recovery, and its own R&D and research cooperation provide the knowledge to develop it, although software for a less familiar energy field carries somewhat more uncertainty.

The overflow flap gate line is closely tied to the established water-level regulation offer, has its own web page and several models, and draws on documented know-how from thousands of projects, making it a natural extension to retain.
